children: American depositary receipts of Baozun climbed after the company said its board has authorized a $10 million buyback program.
ADRs rose 2.6%, to $3.08, in premarket trading Thursday. Through Wednesday's close, ADRs are up 6.8% year to date.

The Chinese company, which provides brand e-commerce solutions, said before the bell that it may repurchase up to $10 million worth of its outstanding ADRs over the next 12 months under the new buyback program.
The repurchases may be made from time to time on the open market, or through other legally permissible means, the company said.
Baozun said the repurchases will demonstrate its confidence in its business outlook, as well as ultimately benefit the company and its shareholders.
